description:
Move class-level DNS cache state and methods out of CrestHttpClient into Fetcher::DnsCache. The cache has its own lifecycle, lock, eviction policy, and cleanup registration — none of which are HTTP concerns. Keeps the following as thin shims on CrestHttpClient to preserve public API:
- .dns_max_entries / .dns_max_entries= (delegate)
- .clear_dns_cache / #clear_dns_cache (delegate)
- .clear_expired_dns (delegate)
- .enforce_dns_limit (delegate)
- .ensure_dns_cleanup_registered (delegate)

Also:
- Move DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER to DnsCache
- Move @@dns_cleanup_proc getter to DnsCache
- Eliminate 'return unless @config.dns.cache_enabled' duplication by checking once in DnsCache.get/set
- Make clear_dns_cache (class method) not construct a new client — call the underlying lock directly
- Fold uncommitted spec/dns_cache_spec.cr (require support/crest_http_client_test_helpers) into this work
title: Extract DNS cache to dedicated DnsCache class
